items.text: Renaming files, folders, and tags is now more reliable, and renaming from file details updates every version.
Shared snapshot links now always open the exact version you shared.
When a newer version replaces one on your device, the older version now moves to Trash automatically and is permanently removed after 30 days.
If you save a new version before an older one finishes uploading, the older version still uploads and appears in your version history.
Browsing large libraries feels faster, and photo swiping and loading states recover correctly while you scroll.
Photo and file imports now clear used phone storage sooner, so long imports keep going more smoothly.
Clearing local data now removes leftover device files more completely, and Clear local files finishes faster with accurate freed-space totals.
Uploads are more reliable with clearer status for waiting files, full storage, retries, and files moved to trash.
Uploads can now continue in the background on Wi-Fi. Turn on Upload in the background in the menu.
Share files with anyone using a link, and manage or revoke links at any time.
Deleted files now go to a new Trash, where you can restore them.
Faster, more reliable downloads that use less storage space.
Smoother photo backup and imports, with better raw photo support.
More reliable syncing between your devices.
Improved VoiceOver support and stability fixes.
Improved TalkBack support and stability fixes.
